params.name: d_front_hump
params.source: LTSM 1977 p2A-4 Fig 2A-3 row KA105: D(+) 19-7/8 minus C 17 = 2-7/8 in = half the inside depth

params.name: d_kickup_top
params.source: between d_center and d_rear, at K

params.name: d_rear
params.source: LTSM 1977 p2A-4 Fig 2A-3 row KA105: N(+) 17-3/4 minus M 15-5/8 = 2-1/8 in = half the inside depth (117)

params.name: s_front_axle
params.source: front axle under the front spring: midpoint of B and F (701.5) less 11, so the rear spring midpoint (I, M: 3384.5) sits 11 ahead of the rear axle at +2705

params.name: z_rail_bottom_center
params.source: twin metres; front and rear springs reach the twin's axle centres (z 0.396) with 2-3 in of arch from the FR88 hanger heights; the TurboSquid frame in the twin sits at 0.496. Needs one tape: floor to the rail's bottom flange at the transmission crossmember, and tyre size
